scope.statement: Demonstration only; never bound. Creates one private directory in the signed parent and the signed files in it, runs one attached container that writes through a bind of that directory, and recreates one compose service under the deployment lock with an explicit file list. Nothing that exists is overwritten, renamed, chmodded, chowned or removed, except the temporary of this run once its identity is proved.
